title: The Socks Sorted from the Warm Heap
youtube_title: The Socks Sorted from the Warm Heap | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a warm heap of socks that were not in pairs is awkward for one person. Brisa notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
